definitions.full: H6673. tsav צַו apparently noun [masculine] , dubious word; — in אַחֲרֵיצָָֿ֑ו הָלַךְ Hosea 5:11 usually command, ordinance ; < ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Che Now GASm שָׁוְא ; elsewhere only לָצָ֔ו צַו לָצָ֨ו צַו (|| לָקָו קַו קָו לָקָו קַו ), Isa 28:10 in mocking mimicry of Isaiah's words, and, 28:13 , of the unintelligible speech of ׳י 's foreign agents of judgement; Ges Che Comm. and others (compare AV RV) render command upon command ; Ew Di (carpenter's) rule (+ קַו = line and rule ), from √ צָוָה (whence צִיּוּן ); Du Che Hpt explain as mocking sounds without sense.
